question: May ClawHub export and persist the experimental Claw package contract before the linked Claws RFC is accepted?
rationale: Tests can validate the implementation but cannot decide whether ClawHub should establish this public and stored compatibility boundary while its governing product contract remains under review.

options.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep the draft open and land the schema after maintainers accept the Claw model and lifecycle contract.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental contract
options.body: Explicitly authorize this gated schema slice before RFC acceptance and accept responsibility for any later schema or data migration.

recommendation.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open and land the schema after maintainers accept the Claw model and lifecycle contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked RFC discussion makes this person the strongest visible reviewer for the unresolved product-model choice.
